sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.text: When you submit our contact form, we collect the information you provide — such as your name, company, email address, phone number, and project details — so we can respond to your inquiry.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.text: We use your information only to communicate with you about your inquiry and our services. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Data storage
sections.text: Form submissions are emailed to us through our email service provider. We retain inquiry records only as long as needed for business purposes.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.text: You may ask us to update or delete your personal information at any time by contacting us through the website.

sections.heading: Services
sections.text: Reliable IT Consulting provides network consulting, design, installation, and support services as described on this website. Specific scope, pricing, and timelines are confirmed in writing before work begins.

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.text: All services are quoted individually. Your quote depends on the scope of work, site conditions, and equipment requirements.

sections.heading: Website content
sections.text: Content on this website is for general information only and does not constitute professional advice for your specific situation.
